  • Verify sales orders, delivery notes, purchase orders, contracts, and supporting documents before billing.
  • Ensure billing is completed accurately and within defined timelines.
  • Maintain proper records of invoices, billing documents, and customer accounts.
  • Coordinate with Sales, Operations, Stores/Warehouse, and Accounts teams to resolve billing discrepancies.
  • Verify pricing, discounts, taxes, quantities, and other billing details before invoice generation.
  • Monitor outstanding invoices and coordinate with the Accounts/Collection team for timely payment follow-up.
  • Perform regular reconciliation of billing records with sales, delivery, and accounting records.
  • Assist in preparing billing-related MIS and periodic reports for management.
  • Handle customer queries related to invoices, billing adjustments, credit notes, and payment documentation.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable tax regulations, company policies, and internal control procedures.
  • Maintain confidentiality and accuracy of financial and customer information.
  • Support month-end and year-end closing activities related to billing and receivables.
  • Identify billing errors or process gaps and recommend improvements where required.
  • Perform other finance and accounting duties as assigned by the reporting manager.

Required Qualifications & Skills

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Management, or a related field.
  • 2â4 years of relevant experience in billing, invoicing, accounts receivable.

  • Strong numerical and analytical skills.

  • Communication & Coordination
  • Accountability
  • Integrity & Confidentiality
  • Process Orientation
  • Teamwork

  • Billing error and discrepancy rate
  • Timely reconciliation of billing records
  • Resolution time for billing-related issues
  • Accuracy of billing MIS and documentation
  • Compliance with internal billing and financial procedures

title: Member of Technical Staff Engineering
description:
Overview

Physical Superintelligence is a startup with roots at Google, NVIDIA, Harvard, Meta, MIT, Oxford, Johns Hopkins, Cambridge, and the Perimeter Institute building AI systems to discover new physics at scale. We are seeking engineers to build platform infrastructure at the intersection of computational science, AI systems, and software engineering.

Our mission is to discover and commercialize transformative physics breakthroughs at scale with artificial superintelligence, safely, verifiably, and for broad public benefit.

The last century's golden age of physics gave us transistors, lasers, and nuclear energy. We believe artificial superintelligence will unlock the next one. We're creating the infrastructure to industrialize scientific discovery and usher in this new era.

We have one product: new physics, at scale.

Use this application if you are an engineer, no open engineering role fits your profile, and you want to be considered anyway. We hire excellent engineers when we find them, whether or not a matching role is open. Tell us how your background and ambitions intersect with our mission, and where you would have the most impact.

Â 

Role and Responsibilities

  • Our platform spans distributed systems, data infrastructure, agent systems and evaluation, HPC and scientific computing, developer platforms, product engineering, cloud infrastructure, and security. This application is for engineers who are strong across most of that list, or unusually deep in something important we did not list. The bar here is higher than any single posting.

  • The standard is the same as every engineering role here: full ownership from spec to ship to on-call, and systems other people build on.

  • Be specific about where you would have the most impact and what you would work on first.

  • We review these applications on a rolling basis and respond only when we see a strong fit.

What We're Looking For

  • A track record of shipping substantive engineering work: systems that shipped and mattered, open source people depend on, infrastructure that outlived your tenure. We weight evidence over credentials.

  • Depth in several of the areas above and the range to move between them, or singular depth in something important we did not list.

  • You can walk us through a hard technical decision you made, what you traded away, and what you would do differently.

  • A concrete reason to be here. If AI systems and physical science together is why you are applying, say so specifically.

Nice to Have

description:
Job Purpose

We are seeking a Maintenance Planner to join our Engineering Stores team. In this role, you will be responsible for effectively planning, preparing, and scheduling maintenance activities to support equipment reliability, maximize plant availability, and reduce unplanned downtime. You will work closely with the Maintenance, Production, Procurement, and Spare Parts teams to ensure maintenance activities are prioritized, properly resourced, and executed safely and on time.

Responsibilities:

  • Plans, prepares, and schedules maintenance work orders to ensure they are completed safely, on time, and in full (OTIF).
  • Reviews and prioritizes maintenance work requests based on risk, equipment criticality, and reliability.
  • Prepares work orders by defining the required scope, tasks, resources, materials, and tools.
  • Schedules maintenance activities considering equipment criticality, planned downtime windows, and availability of parts and services.
  • Coordinates with the Spare Parts Coordinator, Storekeeper, Procurement, and Maintenance Execution teams to ensure required materials and tools are available.
  • Manages maintenance task lists and ensures required materials are requested in line with inventory and supply processes.
  • Ensures accurate and timely registration and management of maintenance information within the CMMS.
  • Supports preventive maintenance planning and contributes to the preparation of maintenance budgets.
  • Supports TPM and continuous improvement activities to improve maintenance effectiveness, reliability, and plant availability.
  • Works closely with maintenance stakeholders to improve planning efficiency, reduce downtime, and support reliable execution of maintenance activities.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management or a related field.

Knowledge & Experience:

  • 2â5 years of experience in maintenance planning, operations, supply chain, or a reliability-focused role.
  • Experience in maintenance planning, preparation, and scheduling.
  • Good understanding of supply and inventory management processes.
  • Experience working with a CMMS and/or maintenance planning and scheduling software.
  • Strong planning and organizational skills, with the ability to plan ahead and manage multiple priorities.

  • Understanding of workflow management and maintenance work prioritization.
  • Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams, including Maintenance, Production, Procurement, and Supply Chain.

description:
Overview

As a member of the military, Infantry Soldiers are the Armyâs primary combat fighters and are responsible for closing with and destroying the enemy. They are the core members of the Combat Arms team, which includes Artillery and Armour Soldiers.

Infantry Soldiers are capable of operating anywhere in the world in any environment â Arctic tundra, mountains, jungle or desert â and in any combination of arms, including airmobile and amphibious operations. The primary duties of Infantry Soldiers are to:

  • Expertly operate and maintain a wide range of weapons, including rifle, hand-grenades, light, medium and heavy machine-guns, and anti-tank weapons
  • Use sophisticated equipment for field communications, navigation and night-vision surveillance
  • Inspect and maintain weapon systems, vehicles, survival gear and personal defensive equipment
  • Participate in airborne operations
  • Operate with support elements such as fighter aircraft, tactical and artillery
  • Engage in unarmed combat
  • Employ camouflage and concealment, patrol, assault, defence, and escape-and-evasion tactics.


Work environment


Infantry Soldiers normally work outdoors. Both in training and on operations they live and work in conditions that would resemble those in the field. Infantry Soldiers will be posted to a battalion in Canada, but there are employment opportunities across Canada and on deployed operations around the world.

If you chose a career in the Regular Force, upon completion of all required training, you will be assigned to your first base. While there is some flexibility with regards to postings (relocations), accommodations canât always be made, and therefore, you can likely expect to move at some point in your career. However, if you decide to join the Primary Reserve Force, you will do so through a specific Reserve unit. Outside of training, your chosen Reserve unit will be your workplace on a part time basis, and you will not be obligated to relocate to a different base. As part of the Primary Reserve Force, you typically work one night per week and some weekends as a minimum with possibilities of full-time employment.

Entry plans

  • Direct Entry Options

No previous work experience or career related skills are required. CAF recruiters can help you decide if your personal interests and attributes match the criteria for this occupation.

The minimum required education to apply for this occupation is the completion of the provincial requirements for Grade 10 or Secondary 4 in Quebec.

Foreign education may be accepted.

Training

The first stage of training is the Basic Military Qualification course, or Basic Training, held at the Canadian Forces Leadership and Recruit School in Saint-Jean-sur-Richelieu, Quebec. This training provides the basic core skills and knowledge common to all trades. A goal of this course is to ensure that all recruits maintain the Canadian Armed Forces (CAF) physical fitness standard; as a result, the training is physically demanding.

Infantry Soldiers attend one of three Military Training Centres: The Royal Canadian Regiment in Meaford, Ontario; Princess Patriciaâs Canadian Light Infantry in Wainwright, Alberta; and the Royal 22 e RÃ©giment in Valcartier, Quebec. The training takes 17 weeks and includes the following topics:

  • Use and care of personal and section-level weapons, including rifles, machine guns and anti-tank weapons
  • Field-craft, including personal hygiene and meal preparation, camouflage, sentry duties, signalling, selecting firing positions, tactical movements and lines of advance
  • Construction of field defences, such as trenches and roadblocks, and laying and marking of minefields
  • Navigation by day and by night
  • Patrolling operations
  • Infantry section and platoon tactics, including offensive, defensive and transitional operations

Infantry Soldiers may be offered the opportunity to develop specialized skills through formal courses and on-the-job training, including:

  • Basic Parachutist
  • Parachute Jumpmaster
  • Para Instructor
  • Mountain Warfare
  • Instructional Techniques
  • First Aid Instructor
  • Rappelmaster
  • Nuclear, Biological and Chemical Defence Instructor
  • Urban Operations
  • Close Quarter Combat Instructor

As they progress in their career, Infantry Soldiers who demonstrate the required ability and potential will be offered advanced training. Available courses include:

  • Instructional Techniques
  • Primary Army Leadership
  • Infantry Section Commander
  • Infantry Platoon Second in Command
  • Infantry Company Sergeant-Major
  • Communicator
  • Reconnaissance Patrolling
  • Anti-Armour Gunner
  • Sniper
  • Machinegunner (Heavy and General Purpose)
  • Small Arms Coach
  • 25mm Gunner and light armoured vehicle Crew Commander
  • Winter (Arctic) and Jungle Operations
  • Patrol Pathfinder
  • Tactical Intelligence Operator

Part time options

This position is available for part-time employment with the Primary Reserve at certain locations across Canada. Reserve Force members usually serve part time at a Unit in their community, and may serve while going to school or working at a civilian job. They are paid during their training. They are not posted or required to do a military move. However, they can volunteer to move to another base. They may also volunteer for deployment on a military mission within or outside Canada.

Infantry Soldiers serve with the Canadian Army. They are the Armyâs primary combat fighters, are responsible for engaging the enemy and are the core members of the Combat Arms team, which includes Artillery and Armoured Soldiers. When they are employed on a part-time or casual full-time basis they usually serve at a Forces Infantry unit located within Canada.

Find a Recruiting Centre

Reserve Force members are trained to the same level as their Regular Force counterparts. They usually begin training with their home unit to ensure that they meet the required basic professional military standards. Following basic training, Infantry Soldiers attend one of three CAF training centres for 7 weeks of Infantry training.

Reserve Force members usually serve part-time with their home unit for scheduled evenings and weekends, although they may also serve in full-time positions at some units for fixed terms, depending on the type of work that they do. They are paid 92.8% of Regular Force rates of pay, receive a reasonable benefits package and may qualify to contribute to a pension plan.

title: Engineer Officer

description:
Overview

As a member of the military, Engineer Officers help the army live, move and fight. They are members of the Corps of Royal Canadian Engineers. Together with the Armour, Infantry and Artillery, Engineer Officers are an integral part of the Combat Arms.

The primary responsibility of Engineer Officers is combat readiness. Either working within Canada during an emergency or on international missions, Engineer Officers are responsible for:

  • Constructing habitable camps
  • Breaching minefields
  • Using explosives to destroy a road or bridge
  • Constructing a bridge or ferry
  • Building a combat road
  • Disposing explosives
  • Constructing obstacles


Work environment


Engineer Officers are employed at bases and stations across Canada and on deployed operations around the world. They experience the unique adventures and challenges that come with working in different environments and various terrains â Arctic tundra, tropical jungle, desert, mountains, urban complex â and various climates.

If you chose a career in the Regular Force, upon completion of all required training, you will be assigned to your first base. While there is some flexibility with regards to postings (relocations), accommodations canât always be made, and therefore, you can likely expect to move at some point in your career. However, if you decide to join the Primary Reserve Force, you will do so through a specific Reserve unit. Outside of training, your chosen Reserve unit will be your workplace on a part time basis, and you will not be obligated to relocate to a different base. As part of the Primary Reserve Force, you typically work one night per week and some weekends as a minimum with possibilities of full-time employment.

Entry plans

  • Direct Entry Options
  • Paid Education Options

If you already have a university degree, the Forces will decide if your academic program matches the criteria for this job and may place you directly into the required on-the-job training program following basic training. Basic training and military officer qualification training are required before being assigned.

Regular Officer Training Plan

Due to the requirement for CAF officer to obtain a university degree, the CAF will pay successful recruits to complete a bachelor degree program in the Royal Military College System. Recruits will receive full-time salary including medical and dental care, as well as vacation time with full pay in exchange for working in the CAF for a period of time. Typically, candidates enter the Canadian Military College System as an Officer Cadet where they study subjects relevant to both their military and academic career. In rare instances, based on the needs of the CAF, candidates may be approved attend another Canadian University. A determination will be made on a case by case basis. If you are applying for this program, you must apply to the CAF and it is recommended to apply to other Canadian universities of your choice should you not be accepted for ROTP.

Training

After enrolment, you start basic officer training at the Canadian Forces Leadership and Recruit School in Saint-Jean-sur-Richelieu, Quebec, for 12 weeks. Topics covered include general military knowledge, the principles of leadership, regulations and customs of the Canadian Armed Forces (CAF), basic weapons handling, and first aid. Opportunities will also be provided to apply such newly acquired military skills in training exercises involving force protection, field training, navigation and leadership. A rigorous physical fitness program is also a vital part of basic training. Basic officer training is provided in English or French and successful completion is a prerequisite for further training.

Following basic officer training, official second language training may be offered to you. Training could take from two to nine months to complete depending on your ability in your second language.

Common army phase

After basic training, you will go to the Infantry School at the Combat Training Centre in Gagetown, New Brunswick. You will build upon the leadership training you received in basic officer training in addition to learning the skills required of all Combat Arms Soldiers, including more advanced weapons-handling, field-craft, and section-level tactics.

Engineer Officers attend the Canadian Forces School of Military Engineering in Gagetown, New Brunswick. For the first two and a half months, training focuses on basic combat engineering skills and includes subjects such as:

  • Basic demolitions
  • Mine warfare
  • Obstacle construction
  • Field fortifications
  • Dismounted infantry tactics at the platoon level

It ends with a three-week field deployment where the Engineer Officerâs ability to lead a Troop is assessed. The final nine months of training concentrates on reconnaissance, planning, and Troop-level combat engineer tasks. Subjects included are:

  • Bridge building
  • Minefield construction
  • Booby-trap clearance
  • Route denial
  • Bridge demolition
  • Combat road repair and construction
  • Defensive works
  • Timber and rope field machines
  • Destruction of battlefield munitions
  • Construction of temporary camps
  • Breaching various obstacles in the face of the enemy

At the end of the last phase, during a comprehensive four-week field deployment, the skills acquired are assessed.

Engineer Officers may be offered the opportunity to develop specialized skills through formal courses and on-the-job training, including after the first tour of duty with a first line unit, they may choose to specialize in one of the following areas:

  • Combat diving
  • Counter explosive threat
  • Mapping and geodesic support to joint operations
  • Infrastructure engineering to both garrison and deployed installations
  • Technical engineering to support the procurement and management of equipment

Part time options

This position is available for part-time employment with the Primary Reserve at certain locations across Canada. Reserve Force members usually serve part time at an Army Base or armoury in their community, and may serve while going to school or working at a civilian job. They are paid during their training. They are not posted or required to do a military move. However, they can volunteer to move to another base. They may also volunteer for deployment on a military mission within or outside Canada.

Engineer Officers serve with the Canadian Army. Their primary responsibility is combat readiness â to help the army live, move and fight. Together with the Armour, Infantry and Artillery, Engineer Officers are an integral part of the Combat Arms team. When employed on a part-time or casual full-time basis they usually serve with Canadian Army units at locations within Canada.

Find a Recruiting Centre

Reserve Force members are trained to the same level as their Regular Force counterparts. They usually begin training with their home unit to ensure that they meet the required basic professional military standards.

After completing basic officer training, Engineer Officers attend approximately three months of specialized instruction at the Canadian Forces School of Military Engineering in Gagetown, New Brunswick, where they earn their Engineer Officer qualification.

Reserve Force members usually serve part-time with their home unit for scheduled evenings and weekends, although they may also serve in full-time positions at some units for fixed terms, depending on the type of work that they do. They are paid 92.8% of Regular Force rates of pay, receive a reasonable benefits package and may qualify to contribute to a pension plan.

title: Engineering Manager Thailand
description:
About KIRA

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future

Â 

The Role

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead a high-performing engineering team building and scaling products used by millions of users across the region.

This role is for a strong technical leader who can lead engineers, make sound architecture and engineering decisions, and drive products and systems from idea to production. You will be responsible for both the quality of the engineering team and the quality and speed of what the team ships.

You should be comfortable operating across people, product and technology â setting a high engineering bar while keeping the team focused on delivering real customer and business outcomes.

What You'll Own

  • Lead and manage a team of engineers across frontend, backend and full stack development.

  • Own engineering delivery for major product areas, ensuring the team ships quickly without compromising reliability and technical quality.

  • Work closely with product, design, mobile, backend and AI teams to turn ambiguous product problems into clear technical execution.

  • Drive technical architecture and engineering decisions across APIs, databases, integrations, infrastructure and customer-facing systems.

  • Set engineering standards around code quality, system design, testing, observability, security and production reliability.

  • Stay close to the technical work through architecture reviews, code reviews, debugging and critical engineering decisions.

  • Develop engineers through regular feedback, coaching, performance management and clear expectations.

  • Identify performance gaps early and take ownership of raising the team's engineering and execution bar.

  • Improve engineering processes, tooling and automation to help the team move faster and operate at scale.

  • Own production outcomes beyond release: monitor systems, resolve incidents, identify root causes and ensure problems do not repeat.

  • Build a strong engineering culture focused on ownership, speed, technical excellence and continuous improvement.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering background with experience building and shipping real production systems.

  • Experience leading or managing software engineers and owning engineering delivery.

  • Strong technical depth across backend, frontend, APIs, databases, distributed systems or cloud infrastructure.

  • Able to make sound architecture and technical trade-offs while balancing speed, scalability and maintainability.

  • Strong track record of taking products or systems from idea through development, launch and production.

  • Comfortable reviewing technical designs, challenging engineering decisions and debugging complex production issues.

  • Strong people leadership with the ability to coach engineers, manage performance and build high-performing teams.

  • Strong product sense and ability to connect engineering decisions to customer and business outcomes.

  • Able to work fast with ambiguity, establish priorities and drive teams toward clear outcomes.

  • Strong ownership mentality â when something breaks or delivery slips, you take responsibility for getting it back on track.

This Role Is Not For

  • Managers who want to manage people without staying close to the technology.

  • Engineers who want the title of Engineering Manager but do not want accountability for team performance.

  • Leaders who need complete specifications before their team can start.

  • Managers who measure success by meetings, processes or tickets instead of shipped outcomes.

  • People who avoid difficult technical decisions, performance conversations or production issues.

  • Candidates who make vague leadership claims without being able to explain what they personally built, led, improved or scaled.

The Bar

We are looking for engineering leaders with real technology career highlights.

A strong highlight is not just managing a large team or working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or engineering organisation and can clearly explain your contribution.

You should be able to demonstrate both sides of engineering leadership: technical depth and the ability to build a high-performing team that consistently delivers.

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Â 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical / engineering leadership interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

As a Room Attendant, you play a key role in upholding these standards by ensuring every room is clean, welcoming, and ready for occupancy. If you are detail-oriented, dependable, and passionate about creating a positive environment, we invite you to apply and become part of our exceptional team.

Facilities Planner

The Opportunity:

Seeking an energetic and skilled Facilities Planner to work at Indo-Pacific Region! Join our team to lead project planning, data analysis, and collaboration across Pacific installations. If you excel at multi-stakeholder coordination, strategic recommendations, and staff-level planning for military or OCONUS facilities, we invite you to help shape our mission and support operational objectives.

On our team, youâll work on challenging projects for sensitive missions from beginning to end while collaborating with senior leadership. Using computer-related facilities management software and your problem-solving skills, youâll help develop creative solutions for mission-critical projects.

In this role, youâll closely impact the mission byâ¯maintaining infrastructure in government space, such as power, heating, and cooling, closely involved in those aspects such as a government power outage. With mentoring, exposure to challenging projects, and opportunities to learn new tools and skills, we focus on growing as a team to make the best solutions for our customers.

Work with us as we facilitate projects that impact the mission for the better.

  • Lead analyses and solution development for facility planning and management.
  • Perform complex activities as related to the control and management of cost, schedule, risk, and resource optimization. Prepare and/or review facilities estimates and site proposals for client review as to cost and feasibility.
  • Work closely with clients to develop plans and programs responsive to present and anticipated portfolio and facility, or individual space requirements. Recommend planning, design, and construction standards or milestones.


Join us. The world canât wait.

  • 2+ years of experience with planning, coordinating, and managing Military Construction (MILCON) and Unspecified Minor Construction (UMC) and understanding their processes through the Project Objective Memorandum (POM)
  • 2+ years of experience demonstrating and communicating with installations for planning concepts, principles, techniques, and practices of MILCON and UMC efforts
  • 2+ years of experience conducting data analysis and making recommendations regarding facilities planning and data-informed refinement of plans, methods, and techniques during the POM Cycle of MILCON and UMC projects
  • 2+ years of experience working in Pacific Region
  • Experience in using Microsoft Office Suite, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, to engineer complex data models, author formal studies, and design high-impact MILCON and UMC executive briefings
  • Knowledge of concepts, principles, techniques, and practices related to master planning, installation planning, facilities planning, and Facilities Sustainment, Restoration, and Modernization (FSRM), or the civilian community equivalent, such as urban and regional planning, campus, or facilities planning
  • Ability to obtain a Secret clearance

Nice If You Have:â¯â¯

  • Experience with military planning or OCONUS Facility Planning

  • Experience in conducting comprehensive staff-level planning to coordinate, validate, and advocate for multi-stakeholder requirements, ensuring installation capabilities directly supported tenant command operational objectives
  • Experience identifying facility-related needs, resources, and problems, and providing analytical assistance to military and civilian leaders in making decisions on goals, policies, priorities, plans, programs, and methods of implementation designed to support required activities of the installation
  • Experience working independently without specific guidelines to identify facility requirements and interpret, adapt, and apply policies, guides, procedures, regulations, and precedents to new or unique situations
  • Experience collaborating with higher level commands such as United States Forces Japan, Indo-Pacific Command, or Marine Forces Pacific
  • Secret clearance


Clearance:â¯

Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information.

At Booz Allen, we celebrate your contributions, provide you with opportunities and choices, and support your total well-being. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, work-life programs, and dependent care. Our recognition awards program acknowledges employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our values. Full-time and part-time employees working at least 20 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in Booz Allenâs benefit programs. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings, not inclusive of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our total benefits by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site and reviewing Our Employee Benefits page.

Salary at Booz Allen is determined by various factors, including but not limited to location, the individualâs particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. The projected compensation range for this position is $61,900.00 to $141,000.00 (annualized USD). The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of Booz Allenâs total compensation package for employees. You are expected to be on camera during interviews and assessments. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud.

title: Technician
description:
Technician

The Security Centre Limited is seeking a technically capable and customer-focused Technician to join our Systems Department. The successful candidate will be responsible for supporting the installation, commissioning, maintenance, servicing, and troubleshooting of electronic security systems, including intruder alarms, card access systems, CCTV, and commercial fire systems.

The Technician will make a significant contribution to the success of the Systems Department by delivering high-quality technical work, maintaining strong customer relationships, and ensuring projects and service requirements are completed safely, efficiently, and to the satisfaction of our clients.


Location: Cayman Islands

Employment Type: Permanent, Full-Time

Reports to: Systems Department Management


About the Role

This is a hands-on technical role supporting the delivery of electronic security projects and ongoing maintenance services across residential and commercial environments.

The successful candidate will work across the full project lifecycle, from cable installation and device deployment through to control panel termination, system commissioning, troubleshooting, and client handover.


The role will also support related electrical, communications, audio-visual, security lighting, telephone, cabling, and home automation projects, while working closely with the Sales and Systems teams, manufacturers, customers, and other stakeholders.

A key part of the role is ensuring that all work is completed in accordance with company standards, client requirements, project specifications, contractual commitments, and applicable safety requirements.


Key Responsibilities

Installation & Commissioning


â¢ Install electronic security systems and associated equipment in residential and commercial environments.

â¢ Run and terminate cables in accordance with system and project requirements.

â¢ Execute control panel terminations and associated wiring.

â¢ Install security devices, sensors, readers, cameras, panels, and other system components.

â¢ Establish Central Station connections and complete system commissioning.

â¢ Test systems to ensure correct operation and compliance with project specifications.

â¢ Support client handovers and provide appropriate system guidance where required.


Service, Maintenance & Troubleshooting

â¢ Conduct routine inspections and preventative maintenance on security systems.

â¢ Diagnose and troubleshoot system faults and technical issues.

â¢ Carry out repairs and corrective works as required.

â¢ Maintain accurate records of service activities, faults, repairs, and system performance.

â¢ Respond professionally and efficiently to client service requirements.

â¢ Ensure systems remain operational, reliable, and fit for purpose.


Electronic Security Projects

â¢ Assist the Sales and Systems teams with the design, sourcing, ordering, installation, and commissioning of electronic security projects.

â¢ Support both reactive and proactive security projects.

â¢ Assist with project planning, equipment requirements, installation activities, and commissioning.

â¢ Work to agreed labour, equipment, and project timelines.

â¢ Contribute to the successful completion and delivery of projects to customer expectations.

â¢ Identify opportunities for system improvements and additional client requirements.


Related Technical Services

â¢ Perform electrical and civil works associated with security installations.

â¢ Support projects involving security lighting, telephones, audio-visual systems, home automation, and structured cabling.

â¢ Assist with the integration of security systems and related technologies where required.

â¢ Apply sound technical judgement when working with existing infrastructure and client premises.

Customer & Supplier Relationships

â¢ Develop and maintain strong working relationships with product and equipment manufacturers.

â¢ Build positive and professional relationships with commercial and residential customers.

â¢ Communicate clearly with clients regarding technical requirements, project progress, service issues, and completion.

â¢ Represent The Security Centre Limited professionally at all times.

â¢ Maintain a strong focus on customer satisfaction and service quality.


Administration, Compliance & Safety

â¢ Complete administrative tasks, service documentation, project records, and reports requested by the Head of Department.

â¢ Comply with all rules, regulations, policies, and procedures of The Security Centre Limited.

â¢ Comply with applicable requirements and rules established by clients while working on their premises.

â¢ Follow all company health and safety requirements and maintain safe working practices.

â¢ Complete required safety training and ensure all work is carried out in accordance with established procedures.

â¢ Support compliance with the policies and procedures outlined in the Employee Handbook.

â¢ Perform other duties as assigned by the Management Team from time to time.


What We're Looking For

Essential experience includes:


â¢ Experience in electronic security systems, electrical work, telecommunications, structured cabling, or a related technical field.

â¢ Strong practical skills in cable installation, termination, and equipment installation.

â¢ Ability to read and understand technical drawings, wiring diagrams, and system specifications.

â¢ Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.

â¢ Ability to work safely with electrical and electronic equipment.

â¢ Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality workmanship.

â¢ Good communication and customer service skills.

â¢ Ability to work independently and as part of a technical team.

â¢ Ability to manage multiple assignments and work within established project timelines.

â¢ Valid driver's licence and ability to travel to client sites as required.


Experience with intruder alarms, access control, CCTV, commercial fire systems, Central Station connections, security lighting, home automation, audio-visual systems, or structured cabling would be a strong advantage.


The Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone who is:

â¢ Technically capable, practical, and hands-on

â¢ Customer-focused and committed to delivering excellent service

â¢ Strong at troubleshooting and finding practical solutions

â¢ Detail-oriented and committed to quality workmanship

â¢ Reliable, organised, and accountable

â¢ Comfortable working on construction sites, commercial premises, and residential properties

â¢ Able to work effectively under project and service deadlines

â¢ Professional and confident when dealing with customers, suppliers, and colleagues

â¢ Committed to following safety, company, and client procedures

â¢ Willing to continuously develop their technical knowledge and skills


This is an excellent opportunity for a technically minded individual to develop their career within one of the Cayman Islands' leading security companies while working with a broad range of electronic security technologies and projects.


Kindly send your resume/CV to HR at hr@security.ky

With a commitment to craftsmanship and innovation, we specialize in designing and manufacturing high-quality glass solutions for residential and commercial projects.

Founded in 2017 in New York, the company has expanded its presence with offices in Los Angeles, Florida, and Texas. As a nationwide company, we serve clients across America, offering our signature glass products and services to diverse markets.

Following consistent annual growth of 70-80% and with even more ambitious plans ahead, we are expanding our recruitment team and looking for a Cost Engineer-Estimator to help drive our continued success.

Employment Type:

  • Full-time, 8:30 AM - 5:00 PM, New York time
  • Remote work.

Responsibilities:

  • Review architectural drawings and submitted quotes to determine suitable installation options for our systems, including glass, aluminum, and steel partitions
  • Perform precise take-offs for all door and partition openings based on architectural and shop drawings
  • Read and interpret door schedules and hardware sets to ensure accurate product selection and full compatibility
  • Communicate effectively with the sales team to clarify project scope, technical requirements, and deadlines
  • Request necessary documentation, including compliance and regulatory certifications, as needed
  • Prepare detailed quotes that clearly define included materials, scope of work, exclusions, and any relevant assumptions or conditions
  • Identify and correct technical errors made by sales managers and propose appropriate alternatives or solutions

Requirements

  • Technical degree in Mechanical or Civil/Structural Engineering
  • Strong spatial thinking and technical problem-solving skills
  • Proven experience with quantity take-offs from construction and mechanical drawings
  • Confident in reading and interpreting:
  • Civil and mechanical drawings Hardware sets and layouts
  • Proficient in Excel or Google Sheets
  • Basic formulas
  • High attention to detail and accuracy
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and work independently
  • Comfortable working with scaled PDFs (e.g., in Adobe Acrobat)
  • Languages: Russian (fluent), English (Upper-intermediate B2)
  • Available to work full-time aligned with EST timezone (8:30AM-5:00PM)

Benefits

  • Clear opportunities for career development and salary increase
  • Competitive salary and benefits package
  • Work with a diverse and talented group of professionals
  • Supportive and innovative work environment
  • Paid days off and Sick leave

Please note: this is a fully remote, full-time position with a schedule from 8:30 AM to 5:00 PM (New York time).

The candidate should have strong written and verbal English communication skills (B2 level or higher) and a technical degree or proven experience as a Engineer / Estimator.

title: Surveyor I
description:
Job Description

The Surveyor I is an entry or junior-level position for new graduates and/or those candidates with less than five (5) years of experience in an applicable industry. The Surveyor I, under a direct supervisor, performs work involving conventional surveying practices. The primary function is to develop the ability to effectively examine and report on vessels and other marine structures during and after construction relative to compliance with the applicable requirements for maintaining the vessel in Classification with ABS and meeting associated statutory and special service requirements related to Safety of Life at Sea, Loadline, Tonnage, Cargo Gear and Pollution Prevention Certification.

What You Will Do (with the assistance and guidance of an experienced ABS Surveyor):

  • Acts as a professional specialist for the organization in the application of related rules, regulations, requirements, concepts, principles, and processes.
  • Performs routine surveys on classed vessels, platforms, or other marine structures and at manufacturers for classification and compliance with statutory requirements.
  • Prepares technically accurate and timely reports of inspections and surveys performed.
  • Engages in contact with clients to resolve problems within areas of expertise.
  • Maintains survey files in an orderly and up-to-date manner in the area of responsibility.
  • Develops the skills necessary for the administration of office procedures and monitoring of business performance at an assigned port.
  • Through broader and more technically challenging work assignments, the individual must develop a thorough understanding of field operations, policies, methods, and procedures.

What You Will Need:

Education and Experience

  • Qualifications from a tertiary institution within a relevant field of engineering or physical science (minimum two (2) years program); or
  • Qualifications from a marine or nautical institution and relevant seagoing experience as a certificated ship officer, and
  • Proficiency in the English language commensurate with the scope of statutory certification and services and, before assignment, with their future work.
  • Appropriate certification and/or licenses in areas of specialization may be required.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

  • Ability to develop a working knowledge of ABS Rules, Guides, statutory regulations, and related instructions, as well as the ABS Employee Safety Policy.
  • Ability to read engineering plans and have a basic understanding of shipbuilding practices and vessel operations.
  • Ability to perform surveys in the prescribed format.
  • Knowledge of computer programs or software packages related to job responsibilities.
  • Knowledge of related technical interfaces required for group project work.
  • Knowledge of ships' engineering systems and machinery.
  • Ability to communicate, orally and in writing, pertinent information relative to assigned area of technical expertise.
  • Ability to analyze problems and propose solutions.
  • Responsiveness to customers and the ability to work well with others.
  • Ability to become familiar with the ABS Health, Safety, Quality, and Environmental Management Systems.

Physical Requirements:

  • Where allowed by local laws, a pre-employment physical examination is mandatory.
  • The role of surveyor/auditor requires sufficient physical strength, stamina, agility, and both visual and auditory acuity to perform the listed duties effectively.
  • The ability to climb vertical ladders up to nine meters and navigate steep steps is essential.
  • Shall be capable of working at heights on various staging and lifting equipment.
  • Shall be able to maneuver in tight spaces and work inside confined areas for extended periods, including kneeling and crawling.
  • The role may involve exposure to industrial environments, potential injury risks, extreme weather conditions, and demanding physical activities.
  • Shall be able to lift at least 25 lbs. / 11.34 kgs.
  • The use of small tools and the wearing of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), in accordance with ABS safety procedures, may be required.
  • Where allowed by local laws, the surveyor will be required to successfully complete an annual physical that will recertify the individual can perform the physical actions required.

Reporting Relationships:

Will report to the Principal, Senior, or Surveyor-in-Charge of the assigned port. This position does not have any direct reports.

About Us

We set out more than 160 years ago to promote the security of life and property at sea and preserve the natural environment. Today, we remain true to our mission and continue to support organizations facing a rapidly evolving seascape of challenging regulations and new technologies. Through it all, we are anchored by a vision and mission that help our clients find clarity in uncertain times.

ABS is a global leader in marine and offshore classification and other innovative safety, quality, and environmental services. Weâre at the forefront of supporting the global energy transition at sea, the application of remote and autonomous marine systems, cutting-edge technical solutions, and many more exciting advancements. Our commitment to safety, reliability, and efficiency is ever-present, guiding our clients to safer and more efficient operations.

Equal Opportunity

ABS Bureau is committed to the equal employment opportunity of its employees and prohibits discrimination against any employee or qualified applicant based on race, color, creed, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity, age, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, citizenship status or veteran status, or other non-work-related characteristics that may be protected under the law of the Federal Government or specific state employment laws.

Notice

ABS and Affiliated Companies (ABS) will not pay a fee to any third-party agency without a valid ABS Master Service Agreement (MSA) authorized and signed by Human Resources. Any resume, CV, application, or other forms of candidate submission provided to any employee of ABS without a valid MSA on file will be considered property of ABS, and no fee will be paid.

Other

This job description is not intended, and should not be construed, to be an all-inclusive list of responsibilities, skills, efforts or working conditions associated with the job of the incumbent. It is intended to be an accurate reflection of the principal job elements essential for making a fair decision regarding the pay structure of the job. #ogjs

title: AI Field Engineer
description:
About CHAPTERS Group

CHAPTERS Group AG is a Hamburg-based holding company investing in 55+ mission-critical software companies across the DACH region, France, and the Czech Republic. Our companies deliver the digital solutions that keep the public sector and core industries running. What they do matters in daily life.

AI has rapidly disrupted the software industry, and we aim to lead that transformation across our portfolio. Central to this is the AI Core team: we build and operate a shared enterprise AI Hub used by companies across the group, and drive adoption through a network of AI Champions. Each portfolio company has one designated power user who leads AI enablement locally, runs training, and scales usage within their organisation.

Tasks

The Role

You are part of the AI Core team but your work extends beyond it. Most of your time is spent embedded within one of our portfolio groups: responsible for deploying and operating the AI Hub for the companies within that group and integrating AI into their real business processes. Beyond this, you support the M&A team to develop AI driven use cases to support our acquisition strategy. You build production-grade systems, connect AI capabilities to existing infrastructure and make sure what gets deployed actually runs stably in the long term. You step in when complex AI use cases require real engineering work and changes to the companies cloud infrastructure.

What You Will Work On

  • Design and deploy production-grade AI solutions integrated into real operational systems: ERP, accounting tools, email inboxes, and legacy workflows
  • Build, test, and maintain integrations with enterprise services including MCP servers, Microsoft Graph, Git/Bitbucket, and REST APIs
  • You understand that shipping a solution is just the beginning. Your designs gather signals and feedback from operations for a continuous improvement cycle. Ensure AI systems run with full observability: logging, alerting, and audit trails that let non-technical stakeholders understand what is happening.
  • Work closely with AI Champions and portfolio group teams to translate business needs into implementable AI solutions and enable the Champions with your technical expertise to implement more use cases without your help in the future
  • Deploy, configure, and operate AI Hub instances (Open WebUI) for the portfolio companies within your assigned portfolio group: including onboarding, custom model setup, tool integrations, SSO, and ongoing maintenance
  • Support the M&A team to identify new targets, automate outreach and, support Due Diligence of new acquisition targets

Requirements

What We Are Looking For

Required

  • At least 2 years of professional experience in a DevOps, backend engineering, or platform engineering role
  • Python fluency: you write clean, maintainable code and are comfortable owning a codebase
  • Practical experience with cloud infrastructure & production deployments on Azure, AWS, or GCP
  • Solid familiarity with Docker, REST APIs, Git, and CI/CD deployment workflows: including deploying and configuring containerised applications for end-customer environments
  • AI-native: you work with LLMs, know their limits, and have shipped something real using them
  • Strong communication skills: you translate technical decisions into business language and can work effectively with non-technical stakeholders
  • German (native or C2) and English (fluent): both are used daily across teams and OpCos

Bonus

  • Experience integrating AI into ERP, CRM, or accounting systems
  • Familiarity with agentic AI frameworks and tool-calling patterns
  • Infrastructure as Code experience (Bicep, Terraform, or CloudFormation)
  • Experience with enterprise authentication and identity (OAuth, SSO, Azure AD / Entra ID)
  • Prior experience working across multiple companies or in a group / holding structure

Benefits

What You'll Get

  • A dual role with real variety: strategic platform work at group level combined with hands-on implementation inside a Portfolio Platform
  • Become part of CHAPTERS Group, a German serial acquirer with 10x growth in the past five years and high ambitions for what comes next
  • A small, high-ownership team: decisions get made fast, your work ships to production. You are part of the CTO office with a direct line to the leadership team
  • Daily work with cutting-edge AI technologies
  • Space to define how AI gets integrated into operational business systems at group scale: early-stage work with lasting impact across 55+ companies
  • Permanent full-time position, remote-first with regular on-site time
  • A clear path to grow with us: we look for ambitious people who want to build a career, not just take a role. We actively invest in your development: talent reviews, events, conferences, etc.

How to Apply

Send your CV and answer the following questions, no formal cover letter needed:

  • Why do you find it exciting to work with vertical market software companies?
  • Why are you the right person to drive AI in the CHAPTERS Group? What is your “unfair advantage”?

We are looking forward to your application!

title: WerkstudentIn AI Agent Developer
description:
Du hast Erfahrung mit KI und willst sie an echten Kundenprojekten einsetzen? Bei uns baust du AI Agents, die in Produktion gehen. Keine Proof-of-Concepts für die Schublade.

Wir sind ein KI-Startup aus Berlin, spezialisiert auf Automatisierung im Kundenservice. Wir bauen AI Agents, Voicebots und Automatisierungslösungen für Unternehmen im deutschen Mittelstand. Gegründet 2023 von Oscar Schwarz und Ludwig Sickert, aktuell ein Team von rund 10 Leuten. Mit AIdapt haben wir ein eigenes SaaS-Produkt, das AI Agents analysiert und messbar verbessert.

Aufgaben

Diese Rolle ist nichts für dich, wenn du nur auf Konzeptebene arbeiten willst. Bei uns bedeutet AI Agent Development: Code schreiben, APIs debuggen, Conversation-Flows implementieren, Systeme integrieren – hands-on, mit direktem Impact bei echten Kundenprojekten.

Du arbeitest an der Entwicklung echter AI-Agenten, die in Produktion gehen. Das bedeutet:

  • Entwicklung von AI Agents: Aufbau und Implementierung von Chat- und Voice-Agents auf Plattformen wie Parloa, Cognigy, telli oder vergleichbaren Conversational AI Systemen
  • Backend-Integration: Anbindung und Konfiguration externer Systeme über APIs (REST, SOAP, Webhooks)
  • Testing & Optimierung: Durchführung von Tests, Debugging und kontinuierliche Verbesserung der Agent-Performance
  • Technische Dokumentation: Erstellung von technischer Dokumentation für Implementierungen und Integrationen
  • Kundenprojekte: Direkte Mitarbeit an realen Kundenprojekten

Bei uns erhältst du klare Aufgaben, Feedback und kannst Verantwortung Schritt für Schritt ausbauen

Qualifikation

  • Studium in Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Computerlinguistik oder einem verwandten technischen Studiengang
  • Grundlegende Programmierkenntnisse (idealerweise Python, JavaScript/TypeScript) und Verständnis von APIs und Backend-Systemen
  • Du bist bereit, dich in technische Herausforderungen reinzufuchsen und Lösungen zu finden
  • Begeisterung für AI Agents, Large Language Models und moderne Conversational AI Technologien
  • Hands-on Mentalität: Du willst nicht nur planen, sondern selbst umsetzen
  • Gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse
  • Verfügbarkeit von 15-20 Stunden pro Woche

Nice-to-have:

  • Erfahrung mit Conversational AI Plattformen (Parloa, Cognigy, Voiceflow, etc.)
  • Erfahrung mit Workflow-Automatisierungsplattformen wie n8n oder Make
  • Verständnis von Customer Service Prozessen
  • Erste Erfahrung mit LLMs und Prompt Engineering

Benefits

  • Echte technische Verantwortung: Du baust Lösungen, die wirklich produktiv gehen – keine Proof-of-Concepts, sondern AI Agents mit messbarem Impact
  • Cutting-Edge Technologie: Arbeit mit den neuesten Conversational AI Plattformen und Large Language Models‍
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten: Remote-Option und flexible Zeiteinteilung, die sich mit deinem Studium vereinbaren lässt‍
  • Persönliche Weiterentwicklung: Regelmäßiges Feedback und Coaching, um dich fachlich und persönlich weiterzubringen
  • Start-up Culture: Flache Hierarchien, schnelle Entscheidungen, deine Ideen zählen
  • ‍Übernahmeperspektive: Bei guter Performance besteht die Möglichkeit einer Übernahme nach dem Studium‍

So läuft der Bewerbungsprozess ab

Wir halten den Prozess bewusst schlank und transparent:

  • 15 Minuten Telefonat mit HR – Kurzer Abgleich zu Motivation, Verfügbarkeit und Rahmenbedingungen.
  • 30 Minuten fachlicher Austausch mit deinem Manager – Einblick in Aufgaben, Arbeitsweise und technische Anforderungen.
  • Vor-Ort-Termin mit Oscar und Ludwig – Kennenlernen, Blick ins Team und gemeinsamer Abgleich der Erwartungen.

Sende uns einfach deinen Lebenslauf und ein kurzes, fachlich begründetes Statement, warum dich diese Rolle interessiert und was du einbringen möchtest.

Wir melden uns innerhalb von drei Werktagen bei dir.

title: Account Manager (m/w/d) - Eschborn
description:
Über TimeLapse Go

TimeLapse Go entwickelt intelligente Lösungen für die digitale Baustellendokumentation. Mithilfe von künstlicher Intelligenz (KI), vernetzten Technologien (IoT), hochauflösenden Kameras und Zeitrafferlösungen begleiten wir Bauunternehmen, Projektentwickler, Industrieunternehmen und öffentliche Auftraggeber bei der Überwachung, Dokumentation und Analyse ihrer Bauprojekte in Echtzeit.

Im Zuge unseres Wachstums auf dem deutschen Markt suchen wir einen Account Manager (m/w/d), der unsere Kunden nach Vertragsabschluss betreut, die erfolgreiche Umsetzung ihrer Projekte begleitet und zu einer langfristigen Kundenbindung beiträgt.

Die Position

Sie betreuen unsere Kunden nach Vertragsabschluss und stellen gemeinsam mit dem Business Developer den reibungslosen Ablauf ihrer Projekte sicher. Dabei sind Sie für die Qualität der Kundenbeziehung verantwortlich und tragen aktiv zur Kundenzufriedenheit, Kundenbindung sowie zur Weiterentwicklung bestehender Kundenbeziehungen bei.

Darüber hinaus übernehmen Sie die operative Betreuung der Projekte und koordinieren die verschiedenen Beteiligten – Kunden, Business Developer, Technischer Vertriebsmitarbeiter sowie unser Netzwerk externer Techniker – um einen reibungslosen Ablauf unserer Leistungen und eine hohe Kundenzufriedenheit sicherzustellen.

Insbesondere sorgen Sie für eine zuverlässige Planung der Installationen und technischen Einsätze sowie für die Einhaltung der verschiedenen Projektphasen.

Sie arbeiten in einem internationalen Umfeld und stehen regelmäßig im Austausch mit den Teams unseres Hauptsitzes in Frankreich.

Im Rahmen Ihres Onboardings erhalten Sie eine umfassende Schulung am Hauptsitz von TimeLapse Go in Frankreich, um unsere Lösungen, Tools und Arbeitsweisen kennenzulernen.

Aufgaben

  • Nach Vertragsabschluss sind Sie der Hauptansprechpartner für unsere Kunden.
  • Sie stellen eine hohe Kundenzufriedenheit sicher und tragen zur langfristigen Kundenbindung bei.
  • Sie koordinieren die Zusammenarbeit zwischen Kunden, Business Developer, Technischem Vertriebsmitarbeiter und weiteren Beteiligten und stellen so einen reibungslosen Projektablauf sicher.
  • Sie sind Ansprechpartner für unser Netzwerk externer Techniker und koordinieren deren Einsätze.
  • Sie planen und koordinieren Installationen, technische Einsätze sowie den weiteren Projektverlauf.
  • Sie koordinieren die Logistik und den Materialbedarf unserer Projekte.
  • Sie erkennen Anforderungen frühzeitig, behalten die einzelnen Projektphasen im Blick und wirken aktiv an der Lösung operativer Themen mit.
  • Sie identifizieren zusätzliche Geschäftsmöglichkeiten bei bestehenden Kunden.
  • Sie dokumentieren und verfolgen die Projekte im CRM und wirken an der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung unserer Prozesse mit.

Qualifikation

Ihr Profil

  • Kaufmännische oder technische Ausbildung bzw. Studium oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation, idealerweise mit Bezug zu Projektmanagement, Kundenbetreuung oder Vertrieb.
  • Mindestens zwei Jahre Berufserfahrung im Account Management, in der Kundenbetreuung, im Projektmanagement oder in der operativen B2B-Koordination.
  • Sicherer Umgang mit CRM-Systemen und digitalen Tools.
  • Erfahrung in der Bau- oder Immobilienbranche oder mit technischen Lösungen ist von Vorteil.
  • Gute Englischkenntnisse sind erforderlich; Französischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil.

Das bringen Sie mit

  • Ausgeprägte Kunden- und Serviceorientierung sowie sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten.
  • Sehr gute Organisationsfähigkeit und ein gutes Gespür für Prioritäten.
  • Die Fähigkeit, mehrere Projekte gleichzeitig strukturiert, zuverlässig und mit Blick fürs Detail zu koordinieren.
  • Teamgeist und Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit unterschiedlichen Ansprechpartnern.
  • Proaktive Arbeitsweise und Eigeninitiative.
  • Selbstständigkeit und Entscheidungsfähigkeit sowie die Fähigkeit, bei Bedarf gezielt die richtigen Ansprechpartner einzubeziehen.
  • Freude an der Arbeit in einem internationalen Umfeld und am regelmäßigen Austausch mit unserem Hauptsitz in Frankreich.

Benefits

Wir bieten

  • Umfassendes Onboarding und Schulung an unserem Hauptsitz in Frankreich.
  • Firmen-Smartphone und Firmen-Laptop.
  • Ein internationales Arbeitsumfeld.
  • Ein dynamisches Unternehmen mit überschaubaren Strukturen und Wachstumsperspektive.

title: Werkstudent (m/w/d) Projektmanagement
description:
Die Streamergy bringt Energie und Daten zusammen. Als innovativer Software-, Ingenieurs- und Lösungsanbieter digitalisieren wir Prozesse im Bereich der Erneuerbaren Energien, des Netzanschlusses und der Anlagenzertifizierung. Mit unserer 360°-Lösung begleiten wir unsere Kunden von der Netzanschluss-Beantragung bis in die Betriebsphase – und sorgen dafür, dass Photovoltaik- und Batteriespeicherprojekte effizient, sicher und reibungslos ans Netz gehen. title: Security & Compliance Engineer - Remote Germany
description:
About Linro

Linro is a cloud security company building a real-time, agentic cloud-security platform. Teams ship with AI. AI ships with Linro.

Cloud infrastructure changes constantly, and increasingly it's AI agents making those changes, not people. Most security tools only catch problems after the fact. Linro works differently. We enforce what's allowed at every stage, from commit to production. We stop bad changes before they ship, and fix problems in real time once they're live.

We have each been on the receiving end of this problem: running cloud security at scale, building the platforms underneath it, and shipping in regulated systems where a wrong change isn't an option. Founded in Berlin in 2026 and built fully remote across Europe, Linro has a platform that's real and working, with plenty still to shape.

The role

You will own Linro's security and compliance program end to end, starting from a blank page. Your job is to build that from scratch: figure out where we actually stand, find the gaps, and close them across a multi-cloud environment. Automate what can be automated instead of redoing the same work by hand every quarter.

What you will do

  • Take SOC2, ISO 27001 and 42001 from a blank page to audit-ready. Run the gap analysis, document controls and policies, gather and map evidence, track remediation to done, and get us through audit.

  • Automate compliance instead of just babysitting it: build checks and guardrails so we stay continuously compliant, and help ensure our multi-cloud infrastructure (AWS and beyond) is managed as Infrastructure-as-Code with Terraform.

  • Own our compliance evidence end to end: keep it current, mapped, and audit-ready across whatever tooling we run.

  • Support security operations: monitoring, alert triage, and documenting findings.

  • Stay close to how the product is actually built. Our compliance checks run on the same engine we sell customers, so you are testing the product, not filling out paperwork off to the side.

What we are looking for

  • Hands-on experience with at least one of SOC 2, ISO 27001, or ISO 42001: you have run a gap analysis, built and mapped evidence, and taken a program through an actual audit, not just studied the framework. Experience across more than one is a plus.

  • Genuine interest in cloud and information security, governance, and compliance, and the drive to own outcomes, not just tasks.

  • Comfort reading cloud configurations and IaC across multiple providers. Ability to automate scales with level.

  • Careful, structured, and trustworthy. You will handle sensitive material.

Nice to have

  • Hands-on Terraform, and experience with AWS, GCP, and/or Azure.

  • Exposure to a compliance automation platform.

  • Prior general software engineering experience, ideally in the stacks we use day to day (Go, SQL, and cloud infrastructure)

How we work

We are 100% remote across Europe and hire anywhere within roughly two hours of Central European Time (CEST). We get the whole team together in person somewhere in Europe once a quarter for a few days. We work async by default, write things down, and protect people's focus time.

What we offer

  • Real ownership of the security and compliance program from the ground up.

  • Meaningful equity. You are an early employee, and your stake reflects it.

  • Competitive salary, benchmarked to the market.

  • A quarterly European offsite, and a team that takes both the mission and each other’s time seriously.

The honest version

This is early, we are literally at the start today. You would start from a blank page, not maintain someone else's polished program. That is the appeal if you want to build a security and compliance function from scratch and carry it all the way to real certifications. It is daunting if you are looking for a mature program to step into. We hire at multiple levels, so this can be a first serious role or a senior mandate. Either way, you will own real outcomes fast.

  • Senior (T5) • €72K – €85K • Offers Equity

DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.

What sets us apart

What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.

When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.

What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL onLinkedIn,Instagram, and our Blog.

What will you be doing at DeepL?

We are looking for a Manager, Partner Sales to join the DeepL Partnerships Department and lead the DACH region. As part of our Global Partnerships team, you will be responsible for building and scaling DeepL’s indirect business through Value-Added Resellers (VARs), Distributors, and SI partners.

You will drive DeepL’s next stage of partner-led growth — establishing new partnerships for our AI-powered productivity solutions and delivering strong, measurable impact on sourced pipeline and Closed Won Business.

Your responsibilities

  • In this regional position, you will drive accelerated revenue growth for DeepL through the recruitment and management of partnerships that represent DeepL’s next phase of growth beyond translation - into Voice technology and AI-supported productivity.

  • Win new high-value partnerships through strategic relationship-building and commercial negotiations. Identify, recruit, and onboard partners with the reach and expertise to drive DeepL’s market expansion across the DACH region.

  • Manage partner sales performance, ensuring forecast accuracy, pipeline health, and effective execution of agreed revenue targets.

  • Develop and own the DACH Channel Partner Plan that sets direction for all partner engagement, GTM priorities, and revenue planning, with quarterly business reviews and performance alignment with both partner and internal executives.

  • In collaboration with Partner Marketing and Enablement teams, own, drive and coordinate and scale programs for onboarding, enablement, co-marketing, and incentives that help partners accelerate pipeline creation and close rates.

  • Drive partner enablement in close collaboration with DeepL’s Enablement and Marketing teams to ensure partner sellers and engineers are trained and certified on DeepL solutions.

  • Support partner sellers with opportunity qualification, registration, pricing, contract management, and closing support.

  • Collaborate closely with DeepL’s direct sales and regional leadership to ensure alignment, co-sell readiness, and partner engagement throughout the sales cycle.

  • Proactively identify and resolve channel conflicts to ensure positive outcomes and trust between DeepL and its partners.

  • This role reports to the Head of Partner Growth for EMEA and North America, with a close alignment to the DACH Regional Sales Leadership.

Qualities we look for

  • Circa 3-5 years of experience in channel or partner sales within SaaS, AI, or cloud technology companies, with a proven record of building and scaling reseller and distribution ecosystems across the DACH region.

  • Strong commercial background driving multimillion-euro ARR targets through Reseller, Distributor, System Integrator and Cloud partnerships.

  • Track record of managing strategic partnerships in the region, ideally with established relationships across leading resellers, distributors, or telcos.

  • Deep understanding of partner GTM motions - sell-to, sell-with, sell-through - and ability to operationalise these models.

  • Experience building scalable partner programs and working with cross-functional teams (Sales, Marketing, Finance, Legal, and Product).

  • Strong negotiation and relationship management skills, with experience engaging senior executives in complex sales environments.

  • Knowledge of AI, productivity, or enterprise software markets is a plus and will accelerate time to success.

  • Experience with Salesforce and partner management tools such as Crossbeam, Tackle.io, and PRM systems.

title: Video Editor / Cutter Social Media (m/w/d)
description:

Wir suchen einen Short Form Content Creator & Editor, der Reels, Shorts und TikToks entwickelt, schneidet und optimiert. Dein Fokus liegt klar auf kurzen, plattformgerechten Videos, die Aufmerksamkeit erzeugen, unsere Produkte und Athleten stark darstellen und Performance liefern.

We build the AI Hub as a product and support to ship it in every company. Each company owns their HUB and administers it (L1 Support). You are part of the central team that drives features and changes that are of high value for all hubs in the portfolio.

  • Close the loop. Shipping is the beginning. Your designs gather operational signals from the fleet and feed a continuous improvement cycle

Requirements
